text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: canary-prober eu-west-1 — 30% non-200s (body mismatch) in last 1m. PD: INC-3421. https://pagerduty.local/INC-3421

pagerduty-bot: Paging Sarah (oncall-eu) — escalation policy: synthetic-canaries. Contact: +1-555-0123.

Sarah: ack INC-3421 — looking into it.

Raj: saw spikes on prober dashboards, pool-3 reporting 5xx-ish behaviour but product SLIs look nominal, suspect synthetic-only.

Mike: grabbing prober logs now. replaying probe for 10s window.

Mike: quick log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:01Z prober[euw3] check_id=abc123 status=200 body="OK" expected_body="OK v2"
2026-03-15T12:03:02Z prober[euw3] check_id=def456 status=200 body="OK" expected_body="OK v2"
2026-03-15T12:03:03Z prober[euw3] check_id=ghi789 status=200 body="OK v2" expected_body="OK v2"
```
Looks like upstream returned 200s but payload changed — matcher failing.

Raj: that aligns with a non-prod edge tweak that removed version token from health endpoint earlier. Might have leaked to canaries.

Sarah: Confirmed via headers — X-Edge-Commit: abcdef (deployed ~11:58 UTC). Product traffic uses different path, so no customer impact reported.

Sarah: Action plan: 1) pause the canary to stop paging, 2) apply tolerant matcher or update expected body, 3) resume and monitor 5m.

Raj: I'm pausing the canary now: `/prober pause --env eu-west-1 --selector pool=prober-pool-3 --reason "nonmatch-body"`

incident-bot: /prober pause executed by Raj — canary paused. Alerts suppressed for 15m.

Sarah: Good. Mike, please prepare a small matcher change (allow both "OK" and "OK v2") and a config roll. Post the config diff here.

Mike: will do. Pushing matcher patch to runtime config branch and starting a canary config-rollout (matcher-only).

Mike: config diff:
```
- expected_body: "OK v2"
+ expected_body: ["OK v2", "OK"]
```
Rolling now (canary matcher rollout).

Mike: Rollout status: 2/3 prober instances updated, verifying.

Mike: verification replay shows errors dropping to 0 in last 3 checks. Nonmatch rate -> 0.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-3421: Resolved by Sarah. Resolution note: matcher updated to accept legacy payload; canary paused then resumed; no customer impact.

Sarah: Handing off to oncall-apac for patch follow-up and postmortem. Summary: synthetic probe started paging due to a small payload contract change in edge; product SLIs unaffected. Key actions taken: pause canary, update matcher, resume, verify.

oncall-apac: ack — will own follow-up. Please add runbook link & postmortem ticket.

Sarah: Postmortem ticket PM-889 created: https://pmtracker/PM-889 — brief: "Synthetic probe body contract mismatch after edge tweak; false-positive pages."

Raj: added suppression rule tag `synth-noise` and set suppression window to 60m for eu-west-1 to avoid noisy repeats while change propagates.

Mike: added small note to prober runbook with command to quickly widen matcher and how to pause/resume: https://runbooks/internal/prober#matcher-adjust

Sarah: Marking incident as resolved on PD, adding timeline and impact: No customer impact.

Raj: thanks — adding a follow-on task to audit recent edge changes that touch health endpoints.

Mike: thx all :thumbsup:
